Foothills BrewingMossy’s Eats Ales & SpiritsTanglewood Pizza Company

“When NC law changed to require retailers to pay for line cleaning, I decided we should use a company for this service because my team always has something going on and cleaning lines is something that can easily be pushed to later, even though it is so important for beer quality to maintain a proper schedule. I knew Jeff Spaugh’s company, Twin City Draft Services, was the right company for Foothills to use because Jeff is one of the most consistent, trustworthy and loyal people I know. Jeff and his team diligently follow a proper cleaning schedule, and I know it’s going to be done right. We don’t have to check up on him nor wonder if he is coming; they are there in the background making sure quality stays high. To have that piece of mind knowing our lines stay in great shape is comforting because I don’t have to wonder if my lines are clean, I know they are.”

Owner · 20+ years of experience

Jeff Spaugh

I’m the owner of Twin City Draft Services, with over 20 years of experience in the draft beverage industry. I am very hands-on and am in the market daily, cleaning lines, completing service calls and performing installations.

I take tremendous pride in my work and truly care about my customers. My goal is simple: to make sure every system we service is clean, maintained properly, and helping my customers serve the highest-quality product possible.

I’m proud to be someone my customers can count on and always just a phone call away when they need me.

Draft service technician

Dylan Eckler

Dylan previously worked for two years at a local beer distributor as a draft technician. He has worked with Twin City Draft Services since day one and brings nearly four years of draft-service experience to his clients.

Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his girlfriend and long walks on the beach.

Twin City Draft Services

Start with a system that fits.

A draft system should fit the space, the beverage lineup, and the way the venue works. Twin City performs installations and can discuss a new system or changes to an existing one.

New spaces

Planning a bar, restaurant, or taproom? Share your layout and the number of taps you have in mind.

Changes to an existing system

Tell Jeff what you want to add or improve so he can assess the work.

A practical first conversation

Have the cooler location, tap location, and any drawings or equipment details ready.

Before you call

What should I tell the team about a foamy tap?

Note whether one tap or several are affected, when the trouble started, and any recent changes to kegs, cooler temperature, or gas supply.

What information helps with an installation?

Have your business location, planned tap count, cooler and bar layout, and any equipment details ready for Jeff.

Can we discuss recurring cleaning?

Yes. Tell Jeff about your location and number of lines so you can discuss a schedule for your system.
